sources.note: Main homepage. Founded 2004 by Jimmy Chapman, cloud-based EHR + PM platform, $349/month per provider, supports 25+ specialties, connectivity to 30+ hospitals and labs.
About page. Company history, Montgomery AL headquarters, Tier-4 data center hosting, mission statement. Limited detail on customers or team.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. $349/month pricing, certification details (CHPL 15.04.04.1889.MedC.03.00.1.171212), 35 CQMs supported, third-party fees for PI/clearinghouse/lab/payment gateway. Lists all 45 certified criteria.

Products overview page. Lists EHR, PM, scheduling, patient portal, patient kiosk. Clearinghouse integrations (ClaimMD, Change Healthcare, Trizetto, Navicure, Waystar). Direct connection to BCBS Alabama.

EHR product page. One-Click documentation, voice recognition, point-and-click, scanning, image annotation. Surescripts certified e-prescribing with EPCS. LabCorp/Quest interfaces. Alabama Immunization Registry. DIRECT messaging. Updox e-fax.

Practice management page. Claims management (pending/submission/rework), electronic remittance downloading, manual check posting, insurance eligibility, financial statements/letters, revenue reporting with drill-down.
Scheduling page. Multi-provider views, flexible templates, color-coded visit types, insurance eligibility from schedule, copay display, appointment reminders, portal visibility.

Patient portal page. View/update meds/allergies/problems/demographics, lab results, clinical summaries, e-statements, refill requests, appointment requests, online bill pay, messaging, electronic forms (registration/consent/wellness), PDF/XML record download, virtual check-in.
Patient kiosk page. DL/insurance card scanning, check-in, copay display/collection, demographic updates.
LinkedIn company page. 11-50 employees, Montgomery AL, software development, founded 2004. Tagline: Integrated. Simple. Affordable. Cloud-based.

MediSYS support page for MedConnect EHR. MediSYS provides local support, customizations, onsite implementation, and training since 2006. Positions itself as developer/primary support partner for MedConnect EHR.
MediSYS press release. MedConnect v2.3 was the first ambulatory EHR to connect to Alabama's One Health Record HIE. Exchanges medications, diagnoses, lab results, allergies.
2018 BusinessWire press release about Clinigence-MedConnect partnership for clinical data analytics. Page failed to load during research; details unavailable.
